text:
Our freedoms are not free. They have been defended and preserved by generations of brave Americans who answered the call to serve.
 
North Dakota has a proud tradition of military service. Their service is a real sacrifice for them and their families. Today, we say thank you. An extra big thank you to my father, who served in the Army, and my husband Mike, who served in the Navy.
 
Our service members make sacrifices daily so that we are able to live in freedom and safety. To every veteran and military family across North Dakota and our great nation: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and the freedoms you've protected for generations of Americans. We are forever grateful. 🇺🇸
 
This Veterans Day, we honor these extraordinary men and women and recommit to keeping the promises we've made to them. They have given so much for our country, and they deserve our unwavering gratitude and support. If you're a veteran who needs help navigating VA benefits or services, please don't hesitate to contact my office or visit my website. We're here to help.
